name: 7shifts
oneLiner: Restaurant-only workforce platform covering scheduling, time clocking, tip management, payroll and, since 2026, employee training.
bestFor: Independent restaurants through multi-unit and franchise groups that want scheduling, labor-cost control, tips and payroll in one tool built for shift-based hospitality teams.

customers.name: HCI Hospitality (Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers franchisee)

updates.text: Moved to a new plan lineup (free Comp, Essentials, Pro and Premium), effective July 2, 2025.

Launched Employee Training: operators build courses and quizzes, assign them by role, department or location, and track completion inside the same app staff use for schedules. Included in the Premium plan.

features: Drag-and-drop scheduling with sales and labor forecasting
Mobile app for staff to swap shifts, set availability and message the team
Time clock with schedule enforcement through POS and payroll integrations
Labor budgeting and labor-cost reporting against sales
Tip pooling, tip management and payouts
Employee onboarding packages and in-app training courses
Task management and shift checklists for managers

pricing.text: Free Comp plan for one location with up to 15 employees. Paid plans per location per month billed annually: Essentials $39.99 (up to 30 employees), Pro $79.99, Premium $134.99 ($44.99 / $89.99 / $149.99 billed monthly). Enterprise is quoted. Payroll is billed separately. 14-day free trial of Pro.

notes: Pricing page could not be fetched; prices come from search snippets of 7shifts.com (pricing and compare pages). A third-party tracker reported plan changes around late September/early October 2026 (including a Premium price cut), so re-check 7shifts.com/pricing before publishing. A March 5, 2026 PR Newswire release reportedly named new enterprise partnerships with IHOP, HCI Hospitality, Boston Pizza Franchise Group and Hattie B's plus an ADP Workforce Now integration, but I only saw it through aggregator profiles (CB Insights, Fundz), so IHOP and Hattie B's are left out of customers. Employee Training launch date (Sep 9, 2026) comes from a PR Newswire headline listed by an aggregator. Scale claims (55,000 restaurant locations) are vendor-reported.
